name: plinth
description: A free storefront theme for furniture and home goods. Collections become the homepage's rooms and categories, products fill its carousels, and anything without a photo is drawn.

scripts.zip: mkdir -p dist && rm -f dist/$npm_package_name.zip && zip -rq dist/$npm_package_name.zip . -x 'dist/*' 'node_modules/*' '.*' '*/.*' '*.zip' && echo "dist/$npm_package_name.zip"

announcement.description: The line in the bar above the header. Clear it to hide the bar.

sale_url.description: Where the red Sale circle and the On sale link go, e.g. a Sale collection. Empty: the whole store.

promo_title.description: Optional subtitle above the New arrivals row.

sale_ends.description: Flash sale end, as 2026-12-31 or 2026-12-31T18:00. Empty hides the countdown band.

sale_text.default: Flash sale now on. Up to 40% off selected pieces.

about_text.default: We work with a handful of small workshops, choose every material ourselves and keep each design in production for years, not seasons.

studio_image.description: Replaces the bundled workshop photograph in Our studio.

journal_first_image.description: Replaces the first photograph in the homepage journal.

journal_second_image.description: Replaces the second photograph in the homepage journal.

quote.description: A customer's words, shown on the yellow band. Empty hides the band.

values.default: Built to last|Honest pricing|Careful delivery|Easy returns

gram_handle.description: Your Instagram name without @. Empty hides the gallery band.

phone.description: Shown in the footer's contact strip.

contact_email.description: Shown in the footer's contact strip.

address.description: Your showroom, shown in the footer's contact strip.
